text: Three months ago, Aziz printed a ticket at a copy shop.
prefix: Three months ago, Aziz printed a ticket at a copy shop.

text: He logged in to the marketplace website on the shop's computer, and he never logged out.
prefix: He logged in to the marketplace website on the shop's computer, and he never logged out.

text: Last week, he bought a new phone and installed the mobile bank, with a green TAF check.
prefix: Last week, he bought a new phone and installed the mobile bank, with a green TAF check.

text: Today, a stranger at the copy shop opens that old browser, finds the list of sessions, and taps End on the mobile bank on Aziz's new phone.
prefix: Today, a stranger at the copy shop opens that old browser, finds the list of sessions, and taps End on the mobile bank on Aziz's new phone.

text: Two sessions of one person, and one wants the other gone.
prefix: Two sessions of one person, and one wants the other gone.

text: Which one should win?
prefix: Which one should win?

text: In Lesson 21, each session got its tokens and its level.
prefix: In Lesson 21, each session got its tokens and its level.

text: This lesson adds two more facts to every session: when it started, and its rank.
prefix: This lesson adds two more facts to every session: when it started, and its rank.

text: First, the rules that fail.
prefix: First, the rules that fail.

text: Rule one: any session can end any other session.
prefix: Rule one: any session can end any other session.

text: Then the stranger ends the owner, and keeps the door.
prefix: Then the stranger ends the owner, and keeps the door.

text: Rule two: the older session wins.
prefix: Rule two: the older session wins.

text: That sounds fair, but the copy-shop session is three months older than Aziz's new phone.
prefix: That sounds fair, but the copy-shop session is three months older than Aziz's new phone.

text: So the stranger wins again.
prefix: So the stranger wins again.

text: Age alone cannot tell the owner from the thief.
prefix: Age alone cannot tell the owner from the thief.

text: Something else must count: how strongly the session was checked.
prefix: Something else must count: how strongly the session was checked.

text: That is the rank.
prefix: That is the rank.

text: A session has rank two when it is in the master app and its TAF verdict was green.
prefix: A session has rank two when it is in the master app and its TAF verdict was green.

text: It also has rank two when the verdict was yellow and the customer then passed MyID.
prefix: It also has rank two when the verdict was yellow and the customer then passed MyID.

text: When TAF was down and nothing was scored, the session has rank one, until a later green verdict raises it.
prefix: When TAF was down and nothing was scored, the session has rank one, until a later green verdict raises it.

text: Every other session has rank one: every web session, and every session in a side app.
prefix: Every other session has rank one: every web session, and every session in a side app.

text: Now the rule.
prefix: Now the rule.

text: A session can end another session only when that session has a lower rank.
prefix: A session can end another session only when that session has a lower rank.

text: Or when both have the same rank, and the other one is younger.
prefix: Or when both have the same rank, and the other one is younger.

text: Back to the copy shop.
prefix: Back to the copy shop.

text: The stranger's session has rank one.
prefix: The stranger's session has rank one.

text: Aziz's new phone has rank two.
prefix: Aziz's new phone has rank two.

text: So the platform refuses, and writes an audit event and an antifraud event.
prefix: So the platform refuses, and writes an audit event and an antifraud event.

text: Now Aziz opens the list of sessions in the mobile bank.
prefix: Now Aziz opens the list of sessions in the mobile bank.

text: He sees the copy-shop browser, with its app and its start time.
prefix: He sees the copy-shop browser, with its app and its start time.

text: He taps End, and it ends, because rank two outranks rank one.
prefix: He taps End, and it ends, because rank two outranks rank one.

text: Age matters only between equals.
prefix: Age matters only between equals.

text: Two marketplace sessions, both rank one: the older one can end the younger one, but not the other way around.
prefix: Two marketplace sessions, both rank one: the older one can end the younger one, but not the other way around.

text: I think this is a quiet, good idea.
prefix: I think this is a quiet, good idea.

text: The owner usually has the strongest check.
prefix: The owner usually has the strongest check.

text: A thief usually has the oldest forgotten door.
prefix: A thief usually has the oldest forgotten door.

text: So the rank comes first, and the age only breaks a tie.
prefix: So the rank comes first, and the age only breaks a tie.

text: One more rule cuts deeper.
prefix: One more rule cuts deeper.

text: A password change or a password reset ends every other session of the same or a lower rank, whatever its age.
prefix: A password change or a password reset ends every other session of the same or a lower rank, whatever its age.

text: The age rule applies only when the customer ends one session from the list.
prefix: The age rule applies only when the customer ends one session from the list.

text: Lesson 30 uses this.
prefix: Lesson 30 uses this.

text: Each new session also sends a notification: by push to every other session, and by SMS.
prefix: Each new session also sends a notification: by push to every other session, and by SMS.

text: So no new door opens in silence.
prefix: So no new door opens in silence.

text: And there is a second guard: the probation period.
prefix: And there is a second guard: the probation period.

text: A fresh session is the riskiest moment, even after a green TAF verdict and a MyID check.
prefix: A fresh session is the riskiest moment, even after a green TAF verdict and a MyID check.

text: A check can be fooled once.
prefix: A check can be fooled once.

text: So after a new session, a new phone, or a password reset, each app blocks some of its own actions for a while.
prefix: So after a new session, a new phone, or a password reset, each app blocks some of its own actions for a while.

text: Which actions, and for how long?
prefix: Which actions, and for how long?

text: The bank decides, for each app, in the platform's policies.
prefix: The bank decides, for each app, in the platform's policies.

text: The platform does not block those actions itself.
prefix: The platform does not block those actions itself.

text: It does not even know them.
prefix: It does not even know them.

text: Instead, the token of each session carries four facts: when the session started, when its probation ends, its rank, and its level.
prefix: Instead, the token of each session carries four facts: when the session started, when its probation ends, its rank, and its level.

text: The backend of each app reads them, and blocks its own risky actions until the probation ends.
prefix: The backend of each app reads them, and blocks its own risky actions until the probation ends.

text: So the mobile bank and the marketplace can each be careful in their own way, with one shared truth about the session.
prefix: So the mobile bank and the marketplace can each be careful in their own way, with one shared truth about the session.

text: To recap: every session has a start time and a rank.
prefix: To recap: every session has a start time and a rank.

text: Rank two comes from the master app, with a green verdict, or a yellow verdict and MyID.
prefix: Rank two comes from the master app, with a green verdict, or a yellow verdict and MyID.

text: A session ends only lower ranks, or younger equals.
prefix: A session ends only lower ranks, or younger equals.

text: A password change ends all same or lower ranks.
prefix: A password change ends all same or lower ranks.

text: And the probation slows down every new session, in each app's own way.
prefix: And the probation slows down every new session, in each app's own way.

text: Now picture a sharper stranger.
prefix: Now picture a sharper stranger.

text: He talked the mobile operator into a new SIM card with Aziz's number.
